PDF export dependencies (served locally, no CDN or remote score processing)

pdfmake 0.2.20: pdfmake.min.js and vfs_fonts.js
Source: https://github.com/bpampuch/pdfmake/tree/0.2.20/build
Copyright (c) 2014-2015 bpampuch, 2016-2025 liborm85
MIT licence: pdfmake-LICENSE.txt. The distributed bundle retains its
upstream licence comments and embeds its third-party notices.
Literal dash punctuation in the JavaScript distribution is represented with
equivalent Unicode escapes; runtime strings and regular expressions are unchanged.

The bundled Roboto font metadata identifies version 3.011 (2025),
copyright 2011 The Roboto Project Authors.
SIL Open Font License 1.1: Roboto-LICENSE.txt
Source: https://github.com/googlefonts/roboto-classic/blob/main/OFL.txt
Fonts are unmodified and embedded in vfs_fonts.js.

These are pinned browser distributions, not runtime npm dependencies.
Keep both licence files with the distributions when updating or deploying.
